exact: regulation of mesenchymal stem cell apoptotic process involved in mesonephric nephron morphogenesis
narrow: regulation of mesenchymal stem cell apoptosis involved in mesonephric nephron morphogenesis

definition: Any process that modulates the occurrence or rate of mesenchymal stem cell death by apoptotic process that contributes to the shaping of the nephron in the mesonephros.
label: regulation of mesenchymal cell apoptotic process involved in mesonephric nephron morphogenesis
